utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. And could we have appearances for the day, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, counsel. Good morning, everyone in and about the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata and Inger de Ru for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours, and all around the courtroom. Mr. Perisic is represented by Daniela Tasic, Milos Androvic, Deirdre Montgomery, and Tina Drolec, Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Lukic. May the Chamber please move into closed session, and may the witness please be called in.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The matter stands adjourned to the 24th, at 9.00 in the morning, Courtroom I. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 24th day of August, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.45 p.m.,
